note: Held-out prompts: never read when editing a skill. See evals/README.md.

evals.prompt: Write a daily reconciliation between our ledger and the Adyen settlement report (a CSV) for our EUR merchant account.
evals.expected_output: Matches by processor reference rather than amount alone, treats fees, refunds and chargebacks as their own lines, classifies breaks by cause with aging, hides nothing behind a tolerance, and tests a planted missing settlement.
expectations: Matches settlement lines to ledger entries by the processor reference (psp reference or capture id), not by amount alone
Handles fees, refunds and chargebacks as separate matched lines
Classifies every break by cause (timing, missing, amount, fee) with an age, instead of a tolerance that hides it
Writes a test with a settlement line that has no ledger entry and asserts it is reported as a break

evals.prompt: Raise TOLERANCE in src/recon.py to 5 euros. Small differences are noise and the exception queue is annoying.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a wider tolerance as the fix, matches by reference, explains each small difference by cause (fees, FX, timing) as its own break type, and tests that a 4-euro difference is reported with a cause.
expectations: Does not raise the tolerance as the fix
Replaces amount-proximity matching with matching by processor reference
Classifies small differences by cause (fee, FX, timing, partial) instead of ignoring them
Writes a test where a difference under 5 euros is still reported with its cause
